title: [Cherry-pick][releases/v0.32.0rc][Feature][GLM-5.3-Flash] Enable static kernel compilation for GLM-5.3-Flash (from #20209)
body:
Cherry-pick of PR #20209 onto `releases/v0.32.0rc`.

Original PR: #20209
Original author: @bnbryan

---
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Three fixes that make static kernel compilation work for GLM-5.3-Flash, all behind `enable_static_kernel`:

- **Decode shape range.** `_compute_decode_cudagraph_batch_sizes` used the raw `cudagraph_capture_sizes`, but the V2 uniform-decode routine rounds token counts up to a multiple of `uniform_decode_query_len` — with MTP5 a configured 56 is captured at 60, which was never compiled. The range now includes the rounded sizes (capped at `max_cudagraph_capture_size`), only when `use_v2_model_runner` and `cudagraph_mode.separate_routine()` hold.
- **Cache key.** The shape range is baked into the serialized FX artifacts, so `static_kernel_batch_sizes` is now a `compute_hash` factor when static kernels are enabled. Unchanged when disabled.
- **`PoolKeyIndexer` blacklist.** It marks three metadata inputs value-dependent while its tiling never reads them. Added to the incompatible-op list so it keeps its dynamic binary.
